## Aim of the experiment

This experiment investigates whether the **Jellyfish Search Optimiser** can recover a hidden cubic structure from a ten-variable synthetic dataset and whether scagnostic preprocessing improves its performance.

First, we identify the **true generating projection** and run Jellyfish on all ten variables without preprocessing. Next, we use pairwise Stringy05 scores to select promising variables and run Jellyfish again on the reduced dataset.

Finally, we compare both approaches in terms of **Stringy05 score, recovery of the true projection, computational time, and optimisation efficiency**. 

## Generate the dataset

We use the default arguments of `gen_hidden_stringy()`: 500 observations, 10 variables, a cubic pattern, rotation angle 5 degrees and seed 918.



## Setup and generate one dataset

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(tourr)
library(bilbyr)

source("../../../data-raw/hidden_stringy.R")

n <- 500
p <- 10
pattern <- "cubic"
degrees <- 5
theta <- degrees * pi / 180
seed <- 918

set.seed(seed)
X <- gen_hidden_stringy(
  n = n,
  p = p,
  pattern = pattern,
  theta = theta,
  seed = seed
) |> as.matrix()

stopifnot(ncol(X) == 10L, all(is.finite(X)))
colnames(X) <- paste0("x", seq_len(p))
```

```{r}
#| label: true-basis

# True projection matrix (inverse rotation)
A_true <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = ncol(X),
  ncol = 2,
  dimnames = list(colnames(X), c("axis1", "axis2"))
)

A_true["x1", 1] <-  cos(theta)
A_true["x3", 1] <- -sin(theta)
A_true["x2", 2] <-  cos(theta)
A_true["x4", 2] <- -sin(theta)

A_true

# Function to calculate rescaled Stringy05
stringy_index <- function(z) {
  as.numeric(
    cassowaryr::sc_stringy05(
      z[, 1],
      z[, 2],
      rescale = TRUE
    )
  )
}

# 1. Mixed structure (observed x1–x2)
Z_mixed <- as.matrix(X[, c("x1", "x2")])

mixed_score <- stringy_index(Z_mixed)

# 2. Original structure (recovered through inverse rotation)
Z_true <- X %*% A_true

oracle_score <- stringy_index(Z_true)

# Print comparison
cat("Rotation angle:", theta * 180 / pi, "degrees\n")
cat("Stringy05 of mixed x1–x2:", mixed_score, "\n")
cat("Stringy05 of recovered original cubic:", oracle_score, "\n")
```



```{r}
#| label: fig-true-projection
#| fig-cap: "The known generating projection recovers the embedded noise-free cubic structure (up to a common magnitude)."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5

tibble(axis1 = Z_true[, 1], axis2 = Z_true[, 2]) |>
  ggplot(aes(axis1, axis2)) +
  geom_point(colour = "#2679A8", alpha = 0.7, size = 0.8) +
  labs(title = paste0("Known generating projection — Stringy05 = ",
                      round(oracle_score, 3)),
       x = "True projection axis 1", y = "True projection axis 2") + 
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
```


# Run Jellyfish without preprocessing

```{r, include=FALSE}
##| label: run-jellyfish
#| include: false

library(tourr)
library(tidyverse)
library(cassowaryr)

# Stringy05 projection pursuit index
stringy_pp <- function(data) {
  as.numeric(
    cassowaryr::sc_stringy05(
      data[, 1],
      data[, 2],
      rescale = TRUE
    )
  )
}

# Run Jellyfish using all 10 variables
set.seed(1111)

res <- animate_xy(
  X,
  guided_tour(
    index_f = stringy_pp,
    d = 2,
    search_f = search_jellyfish,
    n_jellies = 30
  ),
  max_frames = 100
)

# Extract all recorded bases from the first loop
bases_all <- res |>
  filter(info == "current_best") |>
  pull(basis)

# Calculate Stringy05 for every recorded basis
basis_scores <- tibble(
  id = seq_along(bases_all),
  stringy = purrr::map_dbl(
    bases_all,
    \(A) stringy_pp(X %*% A)
  )
)

# Find the highest-scoring recorded projection
best_id <- which.max(basis_scores$stringy)

A_best <- bases_all[[best_id]]

best_score <- basis_scores$stringy[best_id]

# Print comparison with earlier scores
cat("Mixed x1-x2 Stringy05:", mixed_score, "\n")
cat("Original cubic Stringy05:", oracle_score, "\n")
cat("Best Jellyfish Stringy05:", best_score, "\n")

# Remove near-duplicate bases for a smoother GIF
bases_gif <- tourr::check_dup(bases_all, 0.1)

# Save the recorded bases and scores
saveRDS(
  list(
    bases = bases_all,
    scores = basis_scores,
    best_basis = A_best,
    best_score = best_score
  ),
  "jellyfish_cubic_5deg_results.rds"
)

# Render GIF from the recorded Jellyfish bases
gif_file <- "jellyfish_cubic_5deg.gif"

tourr::render_gif(
  data = X,
  tour_path = planned_tour(bases_gif),
  display = display_xy(),
  gif_file = gif_file,
  frames = 100,
  apf = 1 / 12
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-jellyfish-gif
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-cap: "Jellyfish guided tour of the 10-dimensional hidden cubic dataset at 5°."
#| out-width: "80%"

knitr::include_graphics(gif_file)
```


```{r}
#| label: fig-best-jellyfish
#| fig-cap: "Highest-scoring recorded Jellyfish projection."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5

best_projection <- X %*% A_best

plot_data <- tibble(
  x = best_projection[, 1],
  y = best_projection[, 2]
)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x, y)) +
  geom_point(
    colour = "#2679A8",
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 0.7
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(
    title = "Best Jellyfish projection",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Stringy05 =",
      round(best_score, 4)
    ),
    x = "Projection 1",
    y = "Projection 2"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-jellyfish-comparison
#| tbl-cap: "Stringy05 comparison of the mixed structure, original cubic structure, and best recorded Jellyfish projection."

tibble(
  projection = c(
    "Mixed x1-x2 (5°)",
    "Original cubic (oracle)",
    "Best Jellyfish projection"
  ),
  stringy05 = c(
    mixed_score,
    oracle_score,
    best_score
  )
) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 4)
```

Now, let's use preprocessing.

```{r}
#| label: select-x1-x4

selected_vars <- c("x1", "x2", "x3", "x4")
X_selected <- X[, selected_vars, drop = FALSE]

cat("Selected variables:", selected_vars, "\n")
cat("Number of selected variables:", ncol(X_selected), "\n")
```


```{r}
#| label: run-jellyfish-x1-x4
#| include: false

set.seed(1111)

res_selected <- animate_xy(
  X_selected,
  guided_tour(
    index_f = stringy_pp,
    d = 2,
    search_f = search_jellyfish,
    n_jellies = 30
  ),
  max_frames = 100
)


bases_selected <- res_selected |>
  filter(info == "current_best") |>
  pull(basis)

scores_selected <- purrr::map_dbl(
  bases_selected,
  \(A) stringy_pp(X_selected %*% A)
)

best_id_selected <- which.max(scores_selected)

A_best_selected <- bases_selected[[best_id_selected]]
best_score_selected <- scores_selected[best_id_selected]

cat("Best Jellyfish Stringy05:", best_score_selected, "\n")

bases_gif_selected <- check_dup(bases_selected, 0.1)


gif_selected <- "jellyfish_x1_x4_5deg.gif"

render_gif(
  data = X_selected,
  tour_path = planned_tour(bases_gif_selected),
  display = display_xy(),
  gif_file = gif_selected,
  frames = 100,
  apf = 1 / 12
)
```
```{r}
#| label: fig-jellyfish-x1-x4
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Jellyfish optimisation using four selected variables."
#| out-width: "80%"

knitr::include_graphics(gif_selected)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-best-jellyfish-x1-x4

Z_best_selected <- X_selected %*% A_best_selected

ggplot(
  tibble(
    x = Z_best_selected[, 1],
    y = Z_best_selected[, 2]
  ),
  aes(x, y)
) +
  geom_point(
    colour = "#2679A8",
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 0.7
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(
    title = "Best Jellyfish projection (4D)",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Stringy05 =", round(best_score_selected, 4)
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```
